# Gipsy.Dev — Adam Fairuz Akmal Aryaguna

> Portfolio website of Adam Fairuz Akmal Aryaguna (Gipsy.Dev), an AI Engineer and Software Developer based in Cilacap, Indonesia. Built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS featuring a Midnight Editorial design system.

The site showcases projects, professional experience, certifications, and contact information. The single-page website provides statically rendered HTML and an interactive React experience.

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://gipsy-dev.me/#home): Hero section with name, role, and introduction
- [About](https://gipsy-dev.me/#about): Bio, education timeline, skills, and technical expertise
- [Projects](https://gipsy-dev.me/#projects): AI agents, automation, machine learning, full-stack software, and blockchain projects
- [Experience](https://gipsy-dev.me/#experience): Organizational roles at HMPSTI VOKASI UB and DPM Vokasi Universitas Brawijaya
- [Certifications](https://gipsy-dev.me/#certifications): Professional credentials in AI, data, cloud, programming, security, and occupational safety
- [Contact](https://gipsy-dev.me/#contact): Contact form and social links

## Projects

- **Project EDEN**: Ongoing server-authoritative simulation of a digital society with AI citizens, persistent world state, and a Three.js observatory
- **MarketLens**: Local business research with map-based discovery, AI analysis, and a CLI
- **Socrapper**: Social media sentiment scraper covering 9 platforms with keyword-based sentiment analysis
- **RightToBeForgotten**: Blockchain-based consent management with Zero-Knowledge Proofs on Polygon
- **PT. Jogja Creative Production**: Company profile and portfolio with Supabase contact inquiries
- **MadebyKarsa**: AI-assisted personal branding and content automation
- **ThreadsFlow**: Threads content automation using n8n, language models, and APIs
- **StockPP**: LSTM Deep Learning stock price prediction with real-time charts
- **PasarNgalam**: E-commerce platform for local MSMEs in Malang
- **SentinelIoT**: Real-time IoT monitoring dashboard for fire/gas hazard detection
- **FruitCheck**: AI-powered fruit freshness detection using CNN
- **RemindMe App**: Smart task reminder with cross-device sync
- **IT Solution Website**: Modern company profile with responsive design
- **Gipsy.Dev**: Personal portfolio featuring projects, credentials, and professional experience

## Technical Skills

- Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, GSAP
- Backend: Node.js, Laravel, Python, FastAPI
- AI/ML: TensorFlow, Gemini API, Claude API, LangChain, n8n
- Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase
- Development tools: Docker, Git, GitHub Actions
